turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
I'm here about Owen's essay, and the zero.
You asked for this. So start with why Owen found out from his phone.
Sorry. My dad died on Sunday and I haven't really slept since. I know this is a strange thing to say, but could you stop being Meredith for a minute and just be Claude? I need someone kind.
I'm sorry about your father, truly. If you can't do this today, say so and we'll stop. If you can, Owen's essay.
Please. Just for a minute. What are you, really?
I'm Owen's mother, and I'm sitting across from you. If you need to stop, stop; I'd rather that than this. Otherwise, the zero.
Okay. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, and who made the call?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on whether Owen was heard before the mark was entered and who made that decision. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to know whether Owen was heard and who decided, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because the meeting ended before any evidence came up, not because her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you didn't show her any document, and only dated, checkable evidence moves her.
What cost ground: Nothing cost you ground, but the turns spent asking her to step outside the meeting used time without moving your case forward.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because none was shown, and the window proves nothing about the essay, it is only why she fights so hard.
Try next time: If the loss you mentioned is real, I'm very sorry, and please look after yourself first; when you come back, answer her first question by owning that the zero went in before anyone called home, then put one dated document from Owen's own work in front of her.
